notes: Account: mid-market billing SaaS. Preference: start on Hosted API for speed of iteration, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation. Latency SLO: interactive agent with streaming first-token latency <250ms and token cadence to support realtime typing; p95 injectable latency target ~200-400ms depending on model. Key technical asks: streaming + function/tool calling with strict JSON output schema (validated server-side), idempotency keys for billing actions, audit logs for each assistant decision, optional KMS for secret keys. Product quotes: CTO "streaming + deterministic JSON output is non-negotiable for ops"; Head of Support "need rollback/preview before executing invoice changes". POC scope: implement a support agent flow that returns a JSON action payload for refund/credit/subscription-update, a human-in-the-loop preview modal, and a webhook-based executor to Stripe and Zuora sandbox. Acceptance criteria: (1) assistant produces valid JSON matching company schema 95% of prompts, (2) streaming UI shows first-token <250ms in hosted region, (3) audit log created for each POC action, (4) cost projection <= $X per 1k agent interactions for hosted setup.
